text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During a dance lesson with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3...
Tap, tap, tap...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
âLast one!
The finishing turn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*squeak!*)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Mastering the choreography
is a basic must for an Umadol, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, what Falco is aiming for is
the pinnacle of the Umadol world—a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The real deal for Falco's dance lessons
starts right here...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You know how choreography is all strictly set for each song and position, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, a top Umadol's dance requires
a unique charm found nowhere else—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
On top of doing the same choreography as everyone else,
I've gotta bring out Falco's own unique charm!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco wants to come up with a special pose
that'll make everyone's hearts skip a beat, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let me hear your thoughts too, Trainer!
How can I bring out a truly one-of-a-kind charm?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hah...!
There's nothing to it but steady practice...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Could true cuteness mean naturally standing out
even while doing the exact same choreo?!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco thought... that doing things differently from everyone else
would be my own unique charm.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I guess that's one way to look at it...!
Thank you! Trainer-san☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! I'm gonna practice more than anyone else and become a top Umadol, just you watch♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Smart Falcon dedicated herself
even more intensely to her lessons.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
I knew you'd agree♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To deliver my one-and-only charm
to all the fans watching the stage—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've got to polish my super special appeal
with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so... whatcha think?
Does Falco look cute?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! You're one of
Falco's precious fans too, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back, take your tiiime...
Stick with Falco's lesson, okay?â

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, together with Smart Falcon,
we came up with a special pose.
